'''Paecia''' was a world<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The world was inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="TEA" /> known as the Paecians.<ref name="BoS" /> During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era,<ref name="TCSWE" /> they developed a great civilization<ref name="BoS" /> and founded an empire named the [[Paecian Empire]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The Humans from Paecia then colonized neighboring worlds such as [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Paecian Empire eventually vanished around [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Paecian Empire was created in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'',<ref name="TCoPL" /> and was later mentioned in several other books,<ref name="TCSWE" /> the world of Paecia was only created in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
